sizeNote: This registry holds exactly SEVEN entries. If it ever holds eight, either a genuine irreducible was found (Constitutional Assembly ratification required) or a duplication has occurred (UCI-017 violation). The smallness of this file is a quality signal, not a limitation.

primitives.name: Distinction
primitives.statement: That something can be told apart from something else.
primitives.minimalStatement: That something can be told apart.

primitives.name: Change
primitives.statement: That existence and relation can differ across an ordering.
primitives.minimalStatement: That things can differ across an ordering.

primitives.name: Apprehension
primitives.statement: That a system can represent and respond to existents.
primitives.minimalStatement: That a system can represent and respond to existents.

primitives.name: Purpose
primitives.statement: That a system is directed toward preferred states.
primitives.minimalStatement: That a system is directed toward preferred states.

admissibilityCriterion: A concept is primitive iff removing it reduces expressive power (some true statement becomes inexpressible) AND it cannot be defined in terms of the remaining primitives without circularity.

metaPrinciple: If it exists, it must be describable.
If it is describable, it must be registrable.
If it is registrable, it must be discoverable.
If it is discoverable, it must be composable.
If it is composable, it must be governable.
If it is governable, it must be certifiable.
metaOntology.note: This chain is the derivation of the phase order: describable -> ontology (002); registrable -> registry (004); discoverable -> discovery (004/010); composable -> composition (008); governable -> governance (002/004); certifiable -> certification (all phases).
